title: Humanitarian mission needed in occupied Hola Prystan community, similar to Oleshky operation – local official

title: Ukrainian drones to replace Mavics pass testing, best models to be ordered for military
summary: The Brave1 defense innovation cluster, together with Ukraine’s Ministry of Defense, has tested reconnaissance drones of the Mavic type from nine Ukrainian manufacturers to assess whether the aircraft meet the military’s actual needs and the conditions of the modern battlefield.

title: Over 11,000 foreign nationals fighting for Russia killed in Ukraine – Bloomberg

summary: The pace of Russian forces' advance along the frontline has slowed significantly compared with earlier periods of the war.

title: European Alliance of News Agencies expels TASS

title: Russian attack on Vinnytsia: three injured, over 20 homes damaged

summary: Ukraine's air defense neutralized 80 drones launched by Russian forces against Ukraine from the evening of November 12. Hits were recorded at 24 locations.

title: Russia's war casualty toll in Ukraine up by 2,590 over past day
summary: Russia's total combat losses since the start of its full-scale invasion of Ukraine on February 24, 2022, have reached approximately 1,618,920 personnel as of November 13, 2026, including 2,590 troops killed or wounded over the past day.

title: Zelensky meets with Witkoff and Kushner, outlines key outcomes of Abu Dhabi talks
summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has outlined the main outcomes of the talks in Abu Dhabi, including the largest prisoner exchange, an agreement to continue negotiations, and the inclusion of European representatives in the process.

title: First four L-39 Skyfox aircraft could be delivered to Ukraine next year – Czech FM
summary: The Czech Republic is ready to help prioritize the production and delivery to Ukraine of L-39 Skyfox aircraft made by Czech manufacturer Aero Vodochody. Funding for the purchase of the first four aircraft has already been secured, while Prague has approached international partners to finance the purchase of the remaining 12.

title: France allocates funding to support centers for children returned from Russian deportation – Barrot
